Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly one square, production-ready mascot illustration for a selectable Meow home-screen widget skin. The supplied image is the identity reference for a character already in this cat soundboard app. Reimagine its composition and expression as an expressive modern app mascot, not a faithful enlargement. Bold flat 2D cartoon, chunky simple shapes, clean dark rounded contour where needed, minimal flat shading, oversized readable facial features. Cheeky expressive collectible mascot energy, comparable to emotional language-learning app widgets, but this is an original cat character, not an owl. One character only, a strong silhouette recognizable at 56 pixels. Fill roughly 78% of the square with the cat, centered, keeping ears inside the frame; keep the bottom 12% visually quiet for a label that the app will draw later. The background must fill the whole square with one flat opaque color; do not draw a rounded tile outline or put the icon in a phone mockup. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, badges, scenery, gradients, glossy 3D, fur texture, or drop shadows. Preserve the source character's coat colors and distinctive markings.
Character: an orange tabby with cream muzzle and dark caramel forehead/cheek stripes. Expression: deeply self-satisfied, half-lidded mischievous eyes, one slightly raised eyebrow, tiny crooked smile. Composition: oversized frontal head with two plump orange paws tucked under the chin, like the cat is leaning over a ledge. The face should feel funny and lovable, not mean. Background: warm blush pink #F1C1B6. Keep the orange coat rich and legible.
